comments.value: i agree with you :) also this is how i think it must looks like!
really need this, tired to click on a friend and they are in private world
Here's how it could look. Notice the icon next to the "online/etc status" circle.

This would be a really nice feature for people looking to bounce around worlds to see friends but not looking to play the "request off of 5 people and then decide who to joing out of the ones who accept" game. Also nice for times when connections are sketchy and invites are being weird.
This pretty much got implemented with the new menu.

details: I'd love a icon indicating if my friends are in a private world in the social menu, that would save us a few clicks!
title: Show if friends are in private world in social menu
